# joa.ai

> Jamal Ofori-Adu. Applied AI engineer with a physiotherapy background. Founder of StrydeOS, one method for running an MSK clinic and measuring whether it is growing, live in two UK clinics.

## Pages

- [Portfolio](https://joai.pages.dev/): the work (roles and products) and the craft (interfaces and renders)
- [The week, resolved](https://joai.pages.dev/week-resolved/): an engineering write-up built from git by a scheduled agent run
- [Citrus Jelly](https://joai.pages.dev/citrus-jelly/): a soft-body orange slice rendered in WebGPU
